systems.platform: mobile application on tablets, synchronised over mobile data (SIM cards and monthly airtime supplied by the Ministry of Health and partners)
systems.owner: Ministry of Health, with development partners (JSI L10K named)
systems.tiers: health posts and health centres; 7,808 of 17,903 health posts (46%) said to have adopted it since 2018; a dashboard used to track primary health care units' performance; studied in rural districts of East Shewa zone, Oromia, November 2024
the health sector's national reporting platform; not interoperable with eCHIS, so reporting stays manual

note: A qualitative study of a health-extension app used by health workers at health posts in East Shewa: the tablets, SIM cards and airtime it describes go to health extension workers, and woreda health officials appear only as interviewees. It states nothing about a connection at the woreda administration's or woreda health office's own premises. Both systems are the health ministry's, classed application because woreda health offices are among their users; the parent may prefer central.
